text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I want to get stronger, but I'm still missing something.
...Still, what should I do?)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Taishin!
Marvelous timing☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I was just looking for someone to play with~!
Come hang out with Maya and the gang once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What are you saying—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Wait a second. Rumor has it that playing with them is as grueling as boot camp...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(No, no... even if that were true,
it's a pain, and I have no obligation to go along with itâ)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's head out~☆
Go go☆Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I never said a word about going...
Hey, whoa! Stop pushing me...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, marvelous roller coaster spotted~☆
That's where we're charging next~★

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Isn't this pace way too fast?!
...Still, if I complain now, I feel like I lose!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Taixin-san, you're so strong!
But Maya figured it out too, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(She completely copied my strategy?!
...Damn it, if that's how you want to play it—)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey!
Where are we going next?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I-I really can't take any more...!)
(If it's come to this, my only choice is to run—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, Taishin-san!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I've pretty much figured out their pattern!
To shake them off with what little stamina I have left—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Alright!
With this route, I should be able to get away...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Surely they're not chasing after me anymore, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, even I managed to shake 'em.
Those chaotic, totally unpredictable guys, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe saying it builds character
isn't entirely wrong after all."
